summary: Intermittent power trips and brief network blips on floor 3 linked to kitchen smart-plug
description: Multiple events since 2026-03-20 where a smart-plug in the kitchen area appears to short and cause a downstream circuit breaker trip for the third floor. Each trip correlates with a 1-2 minute network outage for services hosted on floor 3 (workstations, several PoE switches). No server hardware was damaged but the interruptions affected a live customer demo earlier on 2026-03-21. Initial suspicion is a faulty smart-plug or overloaded circuit that also causes transient spikes on the office network UPS. This ticket is for coordinating investigation, temporary mitigation, and follow-up with building facilities and the facilities vendor.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use kitchen smart-plug outlets near kitchenette while several devices (espresso machine, kettle, and two hot-plate warmers) are on; 2) Observe floor 3 office breakers and monitoring sensors; 3) Monitor on-prem network switch logs for loss-of-link events.

workaround: Avoid using high-draw appliances (espresso, kettle, hot-plate) simultaneously while on floor 3 kitchen outlets. Facilities to disable smart-plug cron tasks and remove smart-plug from automated schedules until vendor sign-off.
